title: Review of lab 1's ad3-membrane (IBD) on fresh seeds 7 and 8: replicated; two planted droplets grow, fragment and divide (12 and 10 persistent splits, generation 3, 0 merges) into ~17 droplets that each carry a self-made amphiphile rim (rim/core 3.8-4.0), and the population then freezes
summary: Re-ran threads/active-droplets/worlds/ad3-membrane/world.py unchanged (128^2, t=20000) on seeds 7 and 8. The two planted droplets grow on the fuel into crescents that break into droplets, which then divide by dumbbell pinches (rerun7/sheet.png t=13100-14800); by t~16000 the population is a static array of 16-18 droplets (occupancy 0.12). labkit: 12 and 10 persistent splits, generation 3, 0 merges, persistent-track area ratio 1.5-1.8. The amphiphile psi forms a rim on every droplet: rim/core 3.82 / 3.96, rim/out 11.8 / 12.0, 64/70 and 64/66 individuals membrane-like. psi is made by the droplet reaction (k u c^2, c = (1+phi)/2, so the bath at phi ~ -0.95 makes ~0.06% of the interior rate) and drifts up grad|grad phi|^2, so the layer is self-made and counts under RUBRIC L3's quasi-equilibrium clause; with s=0 it has no back-reaction.

observations.I: rerun7/sheet.png: 16-18 discrete round droplets of bounded size (area ratio 1.77)
observations.B: rerun7/radial.png: psi rim/core 3.82, rim/out 11.8, 64/70 individuals membrane-like; seed 8 3.96 / 12.0, 64/66
observations.D: rerun7/lineage.png: 12 persistent splits, generation 3, 0 merges; seed 8: 10, generation 3; dumbbell pinches at t=13100-14800 in rerun7/sheet.png

seeds_run.result: pass: 12 persistent splits gen 3, psi rim 3.82 (64/70)
pass: 10 persistent splits gen 3, psi rim 3.96 (64/66)

verdicts.limitation: The shell is inert (s=0: no back-reaction) and placed by a drift up |grad phi|^2, so it is a quasi-equilibrium layer that does no work; it is 1-2 px wide and I ran no resolution test. Two founders are planted (S not claimed). Early births are fragmentations of growing crescents; after t~16000 the population is frozen, so division stops. I did not run the psi-source ablation.
